hunks.baseline: It might have been closer to an *imugi* than a true dragon, considering it could neither roam beneath the azure heavens nor wield a dragon pearl.
hunks.sol: Granted, it seemed closer to an *imugi* than a true dragon, considering it could neither roam the azure heaven nor possessed a dragon pearl.

hunks.baseline: This identity-confused bastard knew how to use Breath.
hunks.sol: This bastard with its murky identity knew how to use Breath.

hunks.baseline: I stared with my mouth hanging open as an enormous sphere of water spread across a radius of several dozen *jang*.
hunks.sol: I stared with my mouth hanging open as an enormous sphere of water engulfed a radius of several dozen *jang*.

hunks.baseline: The ground, built up layer upon layer over centuries by sediment flowing down from the Yangtze, collapsed by nearly half in an instant.
hunks.sol: The ground, built up layer upon layer over centuries by sediment flowing from the Yangtze, collapsed by nearly half in an instant.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell…*
hunks.sol: *This is insane.*

hunks.baseline: Since the immense qi belonging to the Mutated Water God Dragon had infused the sphere of water, it was only right to call it Water Breath from now on.
hunks.sol: With the Mutated Water God Dragon’s immense qi infused into the sphere, it was only right to call it Water Breath from now on.

hunks.baseline: I stared in horror as the Water Breath vomited by the Water God Dragon pulverized everything in its path.
hunks.sol: I stared in horror as the Water Breath unleashed by the Water God Dragon pulverized everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: “…You’re completely insane. I felt murderous intent for a moment there without even realizing it.”
hunks.sol: “…You’re completely insane. I felt the urge to kill you for a moment without even realizing it.”

hunks.baseline: One lunatic provoking a horned snake. One rejuvenated old man. And one old man who could hardly look any older.
hunks.sol: One lunatic pestering a horned snake. One rejuvenated old man. And one old man who could hardly look any older.

hunks.baseline: When I confirmed the three of them were safe, a sigh of relief escaped me.
hunks.sol: Once I confirmed that all three were safe, a sigh of relief escaped me.

hunks.baseline: The Water Breath fired by the Mutated Water God Dragon was that powerful. It contained qi that far surpassed the Breath of the Black Wyvern I had personally killed in the past.
hunks.sol: The Mutated Water God Dragon’s Water Breath was that powerful. It contained power far beyond the Breath of the Black Wyvern I had personally killed in the past.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell? It was strong, but I don’t remember it being this strong…*
hunks.sol: *What the hell? It was strong before, but I don’t remember it being this strong…*

hunks.baseline: Was it the effect of Berserk? Or had it finally drawn out all the power lying dormant within it?
hunks.sol: Was it the effect of Berserk? Or had it only now drawn out all the power lying dormant within it?

hunks.baseline: I did not know the exact cause, but it unquestionably had something to do with the pupils that had suddenly turned black.
hunks.sol: I did not know the exact cause, but it unquestionably had something to do with its pupil suddenly turning black.

hunks.baseline: Its utterly black pupils gleamed.
hunks.sol: Its pitch-black pupil gleamed.

hunks.baseline: The monster let out a low growl at the humans who had dodged its attack at the speed of light, then opened its maw again.
hunks.sol: The monster let out a low growl at the humans who had dodged its attack with the speed of a streak of light, then opened its maw again.

hunks.baseline: Along with an immense flow of qi, the waterspouts circling around it surged upward as though being sucked into its wide-open jaws.
hunks.sol: Along with an immense flow of qi, the waterspouts circling it surged upward as though being sucked into its gaping jaws.

hunks.baseline: Even the Wyvern, the modern world’s most prominent dragonkin monster, could not use Breath this quickly or this frequently.
hunks.sol: Even wyverns, the modern world’s quintessential dragonkin monsters, could not use Breath this quickly or this frequently.

hunks.baseline: Before the completed Water Breath could be fired, I swung with all my strength and struck the bridge of its nose, which was slowly spreading wider.
hunks.sol: Before the Water Breath could be completed, I swung with all my strength and slammed my fist into the bridge of its nose as its jaws slowly opened.

hunks.baseline: “You wide-mouth bastard!”
hunks.sol: “You gaping bastard!”

hunks.baseline: The sudden jolt to its body made the sphere of water, which had been nearing completion, falter. But despite accomplishing what I’d intended, my expression hardened.
hunks.sol: The sudden jolt made the rapidly forming sphere of water falter. But despite accomplishing what I had intended, my expression hardened.

hunks.baseline: A punch thrown with everything I had.
hunks.sol: That punch had carried all my strength.

hunks.baseline: Yet the resistance I felt through my fist was incomparable to what I had experienced only moments earlier.
hunks.sol: Yet the resistance I felt through my fist was nothing like it had been only moments earlier.

hunks.baseline: The changes that had occurred in the Mutated Water God Dragon did not consist solely of Breath. Its body had also grown stronger.
hunks.sol: Breath was not the only change that had occurred in the Mutated Water God Dragon. Its body had grown stronger as well.

hunks.baseline: To put it simply, it felt like my fist, which should have smashed through ten wooden boards, had stopped after breaking only five.
hunks.sol: To put it simply, it felt as if a punch that should have smashed through ten pine boards had stopped after breaking only five.

hunks.baseline: I should have changed my approach according to the situation, but my thinking had been too complacent. I grabbed White Flame, which I had shoved between the dragon’s scales.
hunks.sol: I should have adapted my approach to the situation, but I had been too complacent. I grabbed White Flame, which I had shoved between the dragon’s scales.

hunks.baseline: In the blink of an eye, White Flame, which had melted into empty space, passed through my Inventory and reappeared in my grasp.
hunks.sol: In the blink of an eye, White Flame vanished as though dissolving into empty space, passed through my Inventory, and reappeared in my grasp.

hunks.baseline: It was a movement that minimized every action. That would have been impossible without the System, and even I had only recently begun mastering this advanced application.
hunks.sol: Every movement had been pared down to the absolute minimum. It was something impossible without the System, and even I had only recently begun to master this application.

hunks.baseline: The moment the shaft of White Flame settled into my hand, I had already finished preparing and was bringing it down in a single strike.
hunks.sol: The moment White Flame’s shaft settled into my hand, all my preparations were already complete, and I brought it down in a single strike.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the flames slicing through the dense, foglike steam stood the bridge of the black-scaled monster’s nose.
hunks.sol: The flames sliced through the dense, foglike steam toward the black-scaled bridge of the monster’s nose.

hunks.baseline: Behind everything cleaved apart to either side of the spearhead was the nearly completed sphere of water.
hunks.sol: Beyond everything cleaved apart to either side of the spearhead was the nearly completed sphere of water.

hunks.baseline: The Water Breath of the Water God Dragon, which had existed for hundreds of years, met the fire dragon’s claw plunging down like lightning from the heavens.
hunks.sol: The centuries-old Water God Dragon’s Water Breath met the fire dragon’s claw plunging down like a lightning bolt from the heavens.

hunks.baseline: Along with a deafening boom that numbed my ears, red and blue flashes filled my vision.
hunks.sol: A deafening boom numbed my ears as red and blue light filled my vision.

hunks.baseline: That day, the people present at the scene were not the only ones who heard the mysterious roar.
hunks.sol: That day, those present at the scene were not the only ones who heard the mysterious roar.

hunks.baseline: The mountains, rivers, and trees bowed beneath a tremendous boom unlike any peal of thunder.
hunks.sol: Mountains, rivers, and trees bowed beneath a tremendous boom unlike any peal of thunder.

hunks.baseline: Commoners who had secluded themselves indoors to avoid the ominous atmosphere were startled and threw themselves facedown on the spot. Government troops wandering near Dongting Lake to investigate the incident dropped even their spears and fled in terror.
hunks.sol: Commoners who had shut themselves indoors to avoid the ominous atmosphere flung themselves facedown in shock, while government troops roaming near Dongting Lake to investigate the incident dropped their spears and fled in terror.

hunks.baseline: Old men patted grandchildren who had burst into tears and gazed at the sky with worried expressions as they muttered,
hunks.sol: Elderly men patted their sobbing grandchildren and gazed worriedly at the sky as they muttered,

hunks.baseline: “It’s a divine spirit. The divine spirit has grown angry and brought down heavenly punishment on someone. What is going to become of this wretched world…?”
hunks.sol: “It’s the divine spirit. The divine spirit has grown angry and brought heavenly punishment down upon someone. What is going to become of this wretched world…?”

hunks.baseline: From the distant past until now, the supernatural being passed down by word of mouth for hundreds of years had truly existed.
hunks.sol: The divine being passed down by word of mouth for hundreds of years, from the distant past to the present day, had indeed existed.

hunks.baseline: But the spirit beast once worshiped as a divine spirit had fallen into an ugly evil beast, and the heavenly punishment delivered by the enraged Mutated Water God Dragon had been blocked by a single human.
hunks.sol: But the spirit beast once worshiped as a divine spirit had degenerated into a hideous evil beast, and the heavenly punishment delivered by the enraged Mutated Water God Dragon had been blocked by a single human.

hunks.baseline: Deep in a part of Dongting Lake that no one ever visited, the battle between the human and the evil beast continued even now.
hunks.sol: Deep in a part of Dongting Lake that no one ever visited, the battle between that human and the evil beast continued even now.

hunks.baseline: A pained roar shook heaven and earth in every direction.
hunks.sol: A pained roar shook heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: The monster, its maw torn open, writhed and threw its body onto the waters of Dongting Lake.
hunks.sol: The monster, its maw torn open, writhed and flung itself into the waters of Dongting Lake.

hunks.baseline: The river water, mixed with dark-blue blood, surged to a distant height in an instant.
hunks.sol: Water mixed with dark-blue blood surged to a dizzying height.

hunks.baseline: Waves such as one might see only on the distant open sea rose and crashed in every direction. Three figures no larger than specks beside the monster’s enormous body moved one step ahead of them.
hunks.sol: Waves fit for the distant open sea rose and crashed in every direction. Three figures no larger than specks beside the monster’s enormous body darted just ahead of them.

hunks.baseline: Three figures shot forward like arrows.
hunks.sol: Three figures shot through the air like arrows.

hunks.baseline: But one person chose a direction completely opposite to the other two.
hunks.sol: But one of them chose a direction completely opposite to the other two.

hunks.baseline: But rather than answer, Jeok Cheongang thrust one palm toward the approaching wave.
hunks.sol: But rather than answer, Jeok Cheongang thrust one palm toward the oncoming wave.

hunks.baseline: With a heavy sound of splitting air, a hole opened through the center of the enormous wave that had been about to swallow his small, aged body. The water evaporated into steam.
hunks.sol: With a heavy crack of displaced air, a hole burst through the center of the enormous wave about to swallow his small, aged body, and the water evaporated into steam.

hunks.baseline: Then the Sword Energy scattered by Cheongpung mingled with the spray and reduced the pebbles flying through it to dust. Mungyeong shook the water from his short sword and spoke to Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: Then Cheongpung’s scattered Sword Energy mingled with the spray and reduced the pebbles flying through it to dust. Mungyeong shook the water from his short sword and spoke to Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: “It was about fifty years ago. I had just finished taking a bath I didn’t want in a nearby valley when I came out and saw Mount Jiuhua burning like a torch. In the end, I hunted down and killed every last one of those bastards.”
hunks.sol: “It was about fifty years ago. I’d just finished taking a bath I didn’t want in a nearby valley, and when I came out, Mount Jiuhua was going up in flames. In the end, I hunted down and killed every last one of those sons of bitches.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, things worked out, more or less, and people around me started praising me as the Fire King and whatnot. But some insane bastards pointed fingers behind my back. They called me a murderous old man like a death fiend who could kill a thousand people without even blinking.”
hunks.sol: “Well, things worked out well enough, and the people around me started praising me as the Fire King and whatnot. But some insane bastards pointed fingers behind my back. They called me a Killing Ghost of an old man who could kill a thousand people without batting an eye.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong frowned at Jeok Cheongang’s attitude. The old man was not even looking at him and simply continued saying whatever he wanted.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong frowned at Jeok Cheongang’s attitude. The old man was not even looking at him, simply saying whatever he pleased.

hunks.baseline: “It’s nothing. To put it simply, this old man liked Mount Jiuhua. I liked it even more because it was the first home I had ever had in my life. Through the Great Faction War, I made sure every bastard in the world understood that anyone who touched what belonged to me would be crushed by any means necessary. But…”
hunks.sol: “It’s nothing. To put it simply, this old man liked Mount Jiuhua. I liked it even more because it was the first home I could call my own. During the Great Faction War, I drilled it into every bastard under heaven that I’d crush anyone who touched what belonged to me, no matter what it took. But…”

hunks.baseline: “That damned bastard doesn’t seem to know that. Then again, if it had known, it wouldn’t have touched my Disciple without a shred of fear.”
hunks.sol: “That damned bastard doesn’t seem to know that. Then again, if it had known, it wouldn’t have dared lay a hand on my Disciple.”

hunks.baseline: “You really do whatever you please. It sounds like you never learned water arts after all.”
hunks.sol: “You really do whatever you please. So after all that, you never learned water arts.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. We’ll figure it out somehow.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. We’ll manage somehow.”

hunks.baseline: “We have no friendship between us, but I would like to tell you to be careful.”
hunks.sol: “We’re hardly friends, but even I feel compelled to tell you to be careful.”

hunks.baseline: “I feel murderous intent rising.”
hunks.sol: “I feel the urge to kill rising.”

hunks.baseline: “If you’re going to kill him, ask the Sword Saint for permission and deal with it quietly. Of course, lend a hand before that.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re going to kill him, ask the Sword Saint for permission and do it quietly. Of course, lend us a hand first.”

hunks.baseline: “Did that fellow Jin Taekyung happen to learn water arts?”
hunks.sol: “Did Jin Taekyung happen to learn water arts?”

hunks.baseline: “I remember training him in the deep valleys of Mount Jiuhua. I’ve never seen anyone who was that bad at swimming.”
hunks.sol: “I vividly remember training him in the deep valleys of Mount Jiuhua. I’ve never seen anyone so bad at swimming in my life.”

hunks.baseline: “…Then we’ll have to drag that monster onto land.”
hunks.sol: “…Then we’ll have to drag that monster onto land immediately.”

hunks.baseline: If they did not step in, Jin Taekyung would drown.
hunks.sol: If they did not act, Jin Taekyung would drown.

hunks.baseline: And just as Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong exchanged determined looks, Cheongpung suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Just as Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong exchanged determined looks, Cheongpung suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “*Hk—* form up!”
hunks.sol: “Pwah! Form up!”

hunks.baseline: “What did you say?”
hunks.sol: “W-What did you say?”

hunks.baseline: The instant the words left his mouth, a huge shadow rippled across the rolling surface.
hunks.sol: The instant the words left Jin Taekyung’s mouth, an enormous shadow rippled beneath the churning surface.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a thunderous shout burst from Jin Taekyung’s lips as he landed on the ground.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a thunderous shout burst from his lips as he landed on the ground.
